fasd_data.description: Path to the fasd data file.

fasd_blacklist.description: List of blacklisted strings. Commands matching them will not be processed.

fasd_shift.description: List of commands that need to be shifted before processing.

fasd_ignore.description: List of commands that will be ignored by tracking.

fasd_track_pwd.description: Track current working directory? Set to false to disable.

fasd_awk.description: Which awk binary to use. Empty string lets fasd auto-detect.

fasd_sink.description: File to log STDERR output. /dev/null by default.

fasd_max.description: Maximum total score/weight. Controls ranking saturation.

fasd_shell.description: Shell used for internal execution. Faster shells like dash/ksh improve performance.

fasd_backends.description: List of default backends (e.g., viminfo, recently-used).

fasd_ro.description: Enable read-only mode? If true, no entries will be added or deleted from the database.

fasd_fuzzy.description: Fuzzy matching level: max number of characters that can be skipped. 0 or empty disables fuzzy matching.

fasd_viminfo.description: Path to .viminfo file for viminfo backend.

fasd_recently_used_xbel.description: Path to recently-used.xbel file for recently-used backend.
